paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5.92 as of August 21, 2026, representing a decrease of 0.84% from the prior close and 10.03% over the past 23 sessions.

There is one new news item in the last 24 hours, with a recent headline from Energy Intelligence discussing the new leadership of Fermi America and their silence on nuclear issues, following the ousting of the company's co-founder and CEO earlier this year.

Recent SEC filings include a Form 4 filing on August 18, 2026, and several other filings on August 14 and 13, 2026, including a Form 10-Q reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026 and an 8-K filing announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026.
